nodes.title: Define landing page content types
nodes.task:
Create and export the following interfaces:
- `export interface HeroContent { headline: string; subheadline: string; primaryCtaLabel: string; secondaryCtaLabel: string }`
- `export interface PricingPlan { name: string; priceMonthly: string; description: string; features: string[]; highlighted: boolean; ctaLabel: string }`
- `export interface FaqItem { question: string; answer: string }`
- `export interface LandingPageContent { hero: HeroContent; pricing: PricingPlan[]; faq: FaqItem[] }`
No imports required.
nodes.acceptanceCriteria: SCOPE: Review ONLY output/types/content.ts. Check: file compiles and implements "Define landing page content types".

nodes.title: Add static landing page content
nodes.task:
Import:
- `LandingPageContent` from `../types/content`
Define and export:
- `export const landingPageContent: LandingPageContent`
Populate `landingPageContent.hero`, `landingPageContent.pricing`, and `landingPageContent.faq` with static SaaS marketing copy.
nodes.acceptanceCriteria: SCOPE: Review ONLY output/data/content.ts. Check: file compiles and implements "Add static landing page content".

nodes.title: Define shared style helpers
nodes.task:
Import:
- `CSSProperties` from `react`
Define and export:
- `export const colors: { background: string; surface: string; text: string; muted: string; primary: string; border: string }`
- `export const layout: { page: CSSProperties; section: CSSProperties; container: CSSProperties; grid: CSSProperties }`
- `export function cardStyle(highlighted?: boolean): CSSProperties`
Return plain style objects only.
nodes.acceptanceCriteria: SCOPE: Review ONLY output/styles/theme.ts. Check: file compiles and implements "Define shared style helpers".

nodes.title: Implement hero section component
nodes.task:
Import:
- `React` from `react`
- `HeroContent` from `../types/content`
- `colors`, `layout` from `../styles/theme`
Define and export:
- `export interface HeroSectionProps { content: HeroContent }`
- `export function HeroSection(props: HeroSectionProps): JSX.Element`
Render a semantic `section` with headline, subheadline, and two CTA links/buttons using inline styles.
nodes.acceptanceCriteria: SCOPE: Review ONLY output/components/HeroSection.tsx. Check: file compiles and implements "Implement hero section component".

nodes.title: Implement pricing section component
nodes.task:
Import:
- `React` from `react`
- `PricingPlan` from `../types/content`
- `colors`, `layout`, `cardStyle` from `../styles/theme`
Define and export:
- `export interface PricingSectionProps { plans: PricingPlan[] }`
- `export function PricingSection(props: PricingSectionProps): JSX.Element`
Render a `section` containing a heading and a responsive list of plan cards. For each plan, render name, price, description, feature list, and CTA control.
nodes.acceptanceCriteria: SCOPE: Review ONLY output/components/PricingSection.tsx. Check: file compiles and implements "Implement pricing section component".

nodes.title: Implement FAQ section component
nodes.task:
Import:
- `React` from `react`
- `FaqItem` from `../types/content`
- `colors`, `layout` from `../styles/theme`
Define and export:
- `export interface FaqSectionProps { items: FaqItem[] }`
- `export function FaqSection(props: FaqSectionProps): JSX.Element`
Render a `section` with a heading and a list of FAQ items using semantic elements such as `dl`, `dt`, and `dd`.
nodes.acceptanceCriteria: SCOPE: Review ONLY output/components/FaqSection.tsx. Check: file compiles and implements "Implement FAQ section component".

nodes.title: Implement simple page header
nodes.task:
Import:
- `React` from `react`
- `colors`, `layout` from `../styles/theme`
Define and export:
- `export interface PageHeaderProps { productName: string; navItems: { label: string; href: string }[] }`
- `export function PageHeader(props: PageHeaderProps): JSX.Element`
Render a top header with brand name and simple navigation links to `#pricing` and `#faq`.
nodes.acceptanceCriteria: SCOPE: Review ONLY output/components/PageHeader.tsx. Check: file compiles and implements "Implement simple page header".

nodes.title: Implement simple page footer
nodes.task:
Import:
- `React` from `react`
- `colors`, `layout` from `../styles/theme`
Define and export:
- `export function PageFooter(): JSX.Element`
Render a footer with short copyright text and one support link.
nodes.acceptanceCriteria: SCOPE: Review ONLY output/components/PageFooter.tsx. Check: file compiles and implements "Implement simple page footer".

nodes.title: Compose the full landing page
nodes.task:
Import:
- `React` from `react`
- `landingPageContent` from `../data/content`
- `layout` from `../styles/theme`
- `PageHeader` from `../components/PageHeader`
- `HeroSection` from `../components/HeroSection`
- `PricingSection` from `../components/PricingSection`
- `FaqSection` from `../components/FaqSection`
- `PageFooter` from `../components/PageFooter`
Define and export:
- `export default function LandingPage(): JSX.Element`
Compose the page in order: header, hero, pricing, FAQ, footer. Pass static nav items with `#pricing` and `#faq`. Wrap content in a root element using shared page styles.
nodes.acceptanceCriteria: SCOPE: Review ONLY output/app/LandingPage.tsx. Check: file compiles and implements "Compose the full landing page".

nodes.title: Review composition and export coverage
nodes.task:
Create a markdown checklist that verifies:
- all section components are exported
- all imports in `output/app/LandingPage.tsx` are relative and resolvable
- hero, pricing, and FAQ sections are present
- pricing links target the pricing section and FAQ nav targets the FAQ section
- all files compile under TypeScript React settings
Export no symbols.
nodes.acceptanceCriteria: SCOPE: Review ONLY output/checkpoints/landing-page-review.md. Check: file compiles and implements "Review composition and export coverage".
